ns2:section.sectionText: This course emphasizes the real world application of theories and research about sport culture, media, and business in an effort to help prepare students to enter the sport industry as media professionals. Course materials cover the current state of the industry and emerging trends. The course includes a 5-day field study in Portland, Oregon where students will meet with industry professionals as well established and emerging sport apparel companies, stadiums, action sport venues, advertising agencies, and Portland Development. Potential visits include: Nike, Adidas, Under Armor, Columbia Sportswear, Moda Center, the Clymb, The Oregonian/OregonLive, Wieden + Kennedy, D3 and Skate Like a Girl. Students may apply for this course until January 26, 2016 at http://go.media.illinois.edu/portland. There is a $1,300-$1,650 fee for this course.
